label: Turkey becomes a vampire and its leader puts on a Dracula cape
description: Turkey seen becoming a vampire, very angry, closing the strait into the Black Sea and beating massive war drums, with the Turkish president putting on a Count Dracula cape with a high collar and a brooch as he does it. First told 8 April 2026 and repeated through August 2026. Sits beside black-sea-strait-closed, which is the shipping half of the same picture.
aliases: Turkey will become a vampire
he put on a Count Dracula cape
beat their war drums

label: Belarus joins Russia, and Turkey with them
description: Belarus seen carrying a Russian flag and trying to join up with Russia, with Turkey named alongside, and later that Belarus is backstabbing and will help Putin with deals being made.
aliases: I see Belarus with a Russia flag
They'll try to join up with Russia
Belarus is backstabbing

label: Confusion in the airlines to make people afraid to fly
description: Great confusion coming to certain airline industries, with an American carrier named, intended to make people afraid to fly. Given in the same vision as the bank cyber attack.
aliases: this great confusion coming to certain airline industries
trying to get people to be afraid to fly

label: A swarm of drones out of Cuba hitting Miami
description: Multiple drones, perhaps a hundred at once rather than one or two, coming out of Cuba to hit Miami and other areas, with a fog or storm over Miami that he could not see through.
aliases: Multiple drones at one time coming out of Cuba to hit Miami
It was lots like maybe a hundred

label: Iran escalates the war as a suicide run
description: Iran acting as a kamikaze, knowing it is a suicide run and doing it anyway on the reasoning that if they cannot have the land nobody will, escalating the war as they go.
aliases: To the point of kamikaze
if we can't have their land, no one will
they escalated the war

label: Tactical area EMPs, a weapon he calls a flex
description: Weapons never seen before about to be used, which he calls a flex: tactical EMPs rather than large ones, designed and perfected to work on a specific limited area.
aliases: weapons that we've never seen before that are about to be used
tactical EMPs
they would work on a specific area

label: A chemical spray released behind a drone and missile barrage
description: Chemical weapons split up and sprayed on people from just behind a barrage of incoming missiles and drones, so that the barrage is the distraction. He says the same plan was prepared for Israel.
aliases: they would be right behind the barrage
they got it where they would try to spray you
the same thing they were planning for Israel

label: A tragic plan Putin is putting into motion
description: That what is about to take place in Ukraine and Russia is more serious than Iran, with Putin devising a plan and putting it into motion, and something tragic about to be seen concerning him.
aliases: Putin is devising a plan and he's putting this plan into motion
you're about to see something that is tragic

label: Banned from Facebook and blocked from posting
description: That Facebook took him down and will not allow new content to be posted from his account, given as the platform suppression he had warned about.
aliases: they already took me down
They banned me
We don't want you over here

label: Words promising good days for America are itching-ear words
description: A warning to sift prophetic words, saying that those telling people good days are coming in America are giving an itching-ear word as in Jeremiah's day. Cuts directly against his own reprieve-window-2026, reprieve-four-years and good-year-2024 claims.
aliases: you got to decipher what you're listening to
they're giving you an itching ear word

label: The black horse rides out of Russia from east to west across Europe
description: The black horse and its rider coming out of Russia and riding from east to west across Europe, given with the war starting up and then the plague following. He corrects his own direction mid-sentence. Distinct from black-horse-rides-east-coast, which is America.
aliases: The black horse is riding from the east to the west in Europe
it's coming out of Russia
